name: codecausality
description: Local-first change impact intelligence for software repositories.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codecausality/core && npm run build -w @codecausality/cli && npm run build -w @codecausality/vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/core && npm run build -w @codecausality/core && npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/cli && npm run typecheck -w @codecausality/vscode
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
